So the credential key stored becomes the zod wrapper object, and subsequent `googleCredentialSchema.parse(credential.key)` calls would fail. Mechanism verified

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts`, `parseRefreshTokenResponse` returns the Zod `safeParse` result object (`refreshTokenResponse`) rather than the parsed token/credential payload (`refreshTokenResponse.data`). In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new code assigns `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(...)` and then persists it via `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key } })`. That would store `{ success: true, data: {...} }` (or `{ success: false, ... }`) into `credential.key` instead of the expected credential shape, which would likely break subsequent usage where the code expects `credential.key` to match `googleCredentialSchema`.
